title: CORA Request: Christopher Lee Watts Investigation Materials (Case #18CR2003)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

o Public Records Custodian / FOIA Officer,

Pursuant to the Colorado Open Records Act (CORA), C.R.S. § 24-72-201 et seq., and Colorado Criminal Justice Records Act (CCJRA), C.R.S. § 24-72-301 et seq., I am submitting a formal request for public access to and copies of records concerning the investigation of Christopher Lee Watts (DOB: 05/16/1985; Weld County District Court Case No. 18CR2003).

Specifically, I request the following disclosable materials:

Audio and Video Footage: Body-worn camera (BWC) footage, police interrogation/interview room recordings (including FBI and Weld County Sheriff’s Office interviews), crime scene walk-through footage, and 911 emergency calls related to the case.

Investigative Reports: Official police summary reports, supplemental case files, interrogation transcripts, witness interview summaries, and polygraph examination documentation.

Forensic & Physical Evidence Logs: Publicly releasable crime scene report summaries, evidence inventory logs, and forensic laboratory summaries.

Fee Waiver / Fee Limit:
This request is made for educational, research, and non-commercial public reporting purposes. I request a waiver or reduction of any applicable fees. If total processing fees are estimated to exceed $50.00, please notify me prior to fulfilling the request with an itemized estimate.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Lina Biiska
